profile_text.body:
Intel Corp is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker INTC, with SEC filings under CIK 0000050863. Its website presents the company under the tagline "Intel Inside - Built for AI" and describes its offering as delivering AI at scale across cloud, data center, edge, and client through hardware and software solutions. The site also notes that Fortune has recognized Intel's innovations in AI, computing, and semiconductor manufacturing.

The site's positioning places Intel's AI business across four deployment environments rather than a single product line, pairing hardware with software. No specific AI products are named in the material available, and the company's own description of its AI work is stated at that general level.

On the legal side, California is the jurisdiction with the largest recorded exposure for the company, with 264 cases. No other litigation is listed.
